Descripción del puesto

Part-time remote US Non-IT Recruiter sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates across US job boards and communities during US PST/PDT hours.

Funciones principales

  • Manage candidate sourcing, screening, and shortlisting for US non-IT roles.
  • Coordinate interviews, follow up with candidates, and maintain recruitment trackers.
  • Source talent across LinkedIn, Indeed, Facebook Groups, Craigslist, Reddit, and career portals.

Requisitos

  • 1–3 years of experience with US recruitment practices and non-IT hiring.
  • Proficiency in Boolean search and multi-platform candidate sourcing.
  • Excellent English communication and ability to work independently during US hours.

Beneficios

  • 100% remote part-time schedule (Monday–Friday).
  • Commission-based earning structure.
